newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle up $1 at $64, limited test - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle up $1 at $64, limited test - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt higher in a very limited test, USDA said.

Inquiry good, demand moderate. Sales confirmed on 1,200 slaughter steers and 800 slaughter heifers early Tuesday. Week-to- date 11,500 head mostly previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 64.00; Dressed basis - Select and Choice 1200 lbs 105.00 hot weights, delivered.

Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1050 lbs 64.00; Pen mixed Commercial to Choice heifers and heiferettes, with end cows 1150 lbs 64.00. Confirmed - 2,000 last week - 42,100 last year - 1,100
